headline: Congress named a post office building at Camp Pendleton, California, the "Camp Pendleton Medal of Honor Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 1103 USPS Building 1103 in Camp Pendleton, California. The building is now officially called the "Camp Pendleton Medal of Honor Post Office." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rates, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: June 13, 2016, the date it was enacted.
